ref.note: Supporting documents: Actiris' own budget (bru-a268-5-p3, annex 1, p. 23: 'Programme 252: Financer les dépenses de partenariats', 'Programme 253: Financer les programmes d'aides à l'emploi'); concordance bru-a268-1-p4 (annex 5a, pp. 149-153) lists 'Werkingssubsidies aan Actiris voor de financiering van de Premies Tewerkstelling' and 'Exploitatiesubsidie aan de privéonderneming die de dienstencheques uitgeeft'. Service vouchers: the regional subsidy is paid per voucher to the issuing company and is demand-driven (see the line's own note); whether a change reaches users through the voucher price or the companies through the amount they receive is a separate regulatory choice, so the phrase stays at 'support per voucher'. hub.brussels and other economy programmes are also in this line but not phrased. corrected: quotes confirmed at A-268/5 part 1 p. 73, Actiris p. 23 of part 3, annex 5a items confirmed (pp. 149-153); Actiris and Innoviris phrases shortened (FR was 10-11 words), 'and its partners' dropped in all three languages to keep them aligned
